text:
lee: FYI — multiple customers reporting 5xx / timeouts from hosted inference since ~02:05 UTC. CS triage shows spike around 02:04-02:10. Sample reqids: r-1a2b3c, r-7f8g9h. Attaching logs in thread, please join war room.
incident-bot: War room created by lee at 02:12 UTC. Runbook: /inc/warroom-template.
sara: oncall here, looking at frontend gateway traces now. seeing many upstream 502/504s, not auth.
raj: runtime—I see high rejection rates on the LRU pool allocs and lots of short-lived worker restarts on host-45 in eu-west.
lee: customers mention elevated latency before the 5xx. Could be queueing + retries.
tim: autoscaler exploded scale-in then back-to-back scale-outs due to a faulty warmup probe; edge connections dropped. suspect probe race with circuit breaker.
maria: CS flagged one customer who got billing errors during retries (duplicate invoice attempts). marking for billing follow-up.
sara: repro checklist — can we reproduce with a concurrent load generator hitting /v1/generate with seq_len 512 and concurrency 120?
raj: attaching quick log snippet — not full stack but shows worker OOM killers and qdepth spike:```[2026-03-18T02:05:13Z] host-45 worker-3 Alloc failed: kv_cache_map resize -> OOM; qdepth=142; inflight=96; retries=12```
tim: that host-level OOM then triggered the runtime process restart, which dropped warmup handshake and the probe considered it unhealthy -> autoscaler ramped up new pods then scaled down too fast. bad interplay.
sara: immediate mitigation — 1) put host-45 into drain (tim) 2) throttle client retries at gateway (raj/sara) 3) bump min-replicas in eu-west to avoid rapid scale-in (raj/tim).
raj: implementing gateway retry cap now: max-retries=2 and enable exponential backoff. rolling patch to canary.
tim: draining host-45 now, moving traffic to healthy hosts. will keep it draining for 30m.
lee: CS messaging: pinged top 4 affected customers with status and ETA. one customer on private dedicated said they saw duplicate billing charges; maria is handling.
maria: on it — asking finance to freeze auto-charge for affected tenant(s) and will confirm reversals if duplicates found.
sara: after initial mitigations latency improved in 10m window; 5xx rate dropped ~85%. monitoring p95.
raj: runtime follow-ups: patch to avoid kv_cache_map immediate resize on burst (small change) — will push code review and staging run.
lee: action items (short): - Raj: runtime patch and staging test (ETA 48h) - Tim: autoscaler probe postmortem and safer scale-in policy (ETA 72h) - Sara: add gateway retry circuit and better per-tenant retry headers (ETA 24h) - Maria: billing reconciliation for affected tenants (ETA 48h) - Lee: customer comms + postmortem draft (ETA 72h)
incident-bot: Recording action items and owners to incidents board #INC-2026-0318-45.
sara: monitoring tweaks — adding alert for qdepth>100 sustained 1m, and runtime restart rate >3/min.
raj: also enabling a short-term KV cache soft-limit so we fail fast instead of OOM-sigkill; will monitor mem pressure.
tim: infra follow-up — add health-check jitter to warmup probe and require 2 successful passes before scale-in.
lee: customer-facing postmortem notes to include: timeline, root cause (kv_cache resize + host OOM -> probe race -> rapid autoscaler oscillation -> gateway retry amplification), mitigations applied, and action items with owners.
maria: once reconciliations done I'll update CS template with billing incident playbook to avoid auto-charges during incidents.
sara: any blockers?
raj: code change needs a perf test on long seq_len workloads, otherwise no blocker.
tim: infra changes need a small infra window; will schedule after approval.
lee: OK — we'll reconvene in 24h to verify progress. thanks all. :thumbsup:
